description: This file defines a SwiftUI view modifier named StatusGlassCardModifier for styling views with a glass-like appearance, involving paddings, rounded rectangle background, stroke overlay, and shadow. It also provides an extension method on View to apply this modifier easily.

classes.name: StatusGlassCardModifier
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that applies a glass-like visual style to views, including padding, background, stroke border, and shadow.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the view content with applied padding, background decoration, border stroke, and shadow.

methods.name: statusGlassCard
methods.description: An extension method on View that applies the StatusGlassCardModifier with specified parameters.
